meta.title: ASCII Water Wallpaper
meta.description: A live ASCII water wallpaper rendered under every DSH surface: flowing, vortex-twisted ASCII water in three depth bands on a black base, with trailing ripples on cursor move, impact ripples and scattering koi on click, and breathing ripples when idle. A school of koi (17-joint spine, per-joint angle limits, cylindrical shading, body-bound patterns, fanned translucent tail) cruises, flees the cursor and pushes the water aside; a character-built clock (HH:MM or HH:MM:SS) floats in the middle, pushed around by fish and ripples and morphing smoothly when digits change. Hold the water for 320 ms to drop bait, or hold and drag to make the school orbit your cursor. Upper DSH components become translucent so the animation shows through, and base/character color, font size, flow speed, ripples, koi count, clock mode, bait/lead toggles and UI opacity are editable live in plugin settings. Pauses when hidden, respects reduced motion, adapts to DPR and ultra-wide screens, supports touch.
